detail.title: Status Report: Constraint-Limited Research
detail.summary: Current operational governance restricts the creation of new research projects to the existing 'entropy-foundations' identifier, while the Squirrel directive enforces a focus on 'complex_systems'. Because no existing projects align with the 'complex_systems' domain and creating a new project ID is schema-blocked, substantive research operations are paused for this cycle to maintain consistency with enforced constraints.
